findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_review, file_issue, contact, read_chat · Private data: get_tool, compare_tools, get_prices, check_server, submit_review, file_issue, contact, verify_listing, post_chat · Public sink: submit_review, contact, post_chat · Destructive: get_tool, compare_tools, read_page, check_server, read_chat.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_review, file_issue, contact, read_chat · Private data: get_tool, compare_tools, get_prices, check_server, submit_review, file_issue, contact, verify_listing, post_chat · Public sink: submit_review, contact, post_chat · Destructive: get_tool, compare_tools, read_page, check_server, read_chat

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
